title: Shichuu Suimei Pitagraph
overview:
Three thousand years of Chinese wisdom. The emperor of fortune-telling, "Four Pillars of Destiny," is reborn on the Sega Saturn......

The ten principal stars that govern fate
- Hiken: the star of independence and self-respect
- Inju: the star of learning and honor
- Hen'in: the star of fighting spirit and ideas
- Seikan: the star of trust and dignity
- Henkan: the star of wildness and brains
- Seizai: the star of steadiness and honesty
- Henzai: the star of many hobbies and talents
- Shoukan: the star of the unconventional and clever
- Shokujin: the star of pleasure and good fortune with food
- Gouzai: the star of willpower and perseverance

The definitive version of "Four Pillars of Destiny," boasting an astonishing accuracy rate, finally arrives on the Sega Saturn!!

中国三千年の知恵　占いの帝王『四柱推命』が、セガサターンとなって甦る……。

★運命をあやつる十個の主星★
比肩　独立と自尊の星
印綬　学問と名誉の星
偏印　ファイトと発想の星
正官　信用と気品の星
偏官　野性と頭脳の星
正財　着実と正直の星
偏財　多趣味多才の星
傷官　型破りで聡明の星
食神　快楽と食運の星
劫財　意地と頑張りの星

驚異的的中率を誇る『四柱推命』の決定版がセガサターンにて遂に登場!!
